decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet sits close to the firm's established Rx offer and has its own product page; with an expanding, investing firm holding slack and no sign of a shortfall against aspirations, management has no trigger for problemistic search and keeps it.

The generic antidepressant is distant from the core and faces price pressure under reimbursement contracts, so a shortfall is more likely, but one year after launch and with growth-driven slack the firm would carry it while results remain uncertain.

The combination antihypertensive fits the firm's established offer and its strategy of improved formulations that support adherence, and its own product page signals commitment, so dropping it is unlikely.

The bone and joint supplement is only mentioned on the website, which suggests lower prominence, but it matches the strategy of building pharmacy-exclusive self-care products, and available slack lets management give it more time before judging it against aspirations.
